IFRS 15 states that an entity that grants the right to return the product should recognise the revenue for the transferred
products at the amount of consideration to which the entity expects to be entitled, a refund liability, and an asset for its
right to recover products. ROVI recognises its revenues net of estimated returns at the date of sale, together with the
refund liability. The Group does not recognise an asset for its right to recover products because, based on experience
and the type of product sold, the goods returned can no longer be sold or form part of the Group's inventories.
